title: The First Kavi | ECHO//100 Episode 80
description:
Kavi emerges from the shattered glass dimension into a reality that no longer loops. He must confront his final shadow to secure his sovereign future. Episode 80 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is a work of original fiction generated with AI assistance.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: The glass world detonates, leaving Kavi standing in the silence of his own living room.
scenes.caption: Shattered glass reality
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses standing in a normal living room, shards of glass suspended in mid-air behind him, cinematic lighting.

scenes.text: He touches the wall; it is solid, cold, and undeniably real for the first time.
scenes.caption: Solid walls remain
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi's hand touching a wooden wall, the texture is realistic, warm ambient sunlight filtering through a window.

scenes.text: Byte flickers out of existence, leaving behind a fading trail of cyan light and static.
scenes.caption: Byte fades away
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, the white floating entity, dissolving into cyan pixels in the center of the living room, Kavi watching with wide eyes.

scenes.text: Kavi steps onto the porch, realizing the red door that trapped him has finally vanished.
scenes.caption: The door disappears
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi standing on his porch looking at a blank wall where a red door used to be, red hoodie blowing in the wind.

scenes.text: History settles within his mind; he is the only version of himself left standing now.
scenes.caption: The unique Kavi
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi standing alone on the porch, his shadow casting a single, sharp silhouette against the porch floor.

scenes.text: Null sits on the porch swing, shedding his glitchy form to reveal a human face.
scenes.caption: Null becomes human
scenes.image_prompt: Null sitting on a porch swing, his black-purple glitch skin turning into pale human skin, red eyes remaining intense and focused.

scenes.text: Null smiles, gesture inviting, as he holds out a heavy, rusted physical iron door key.
scenes.caption: The final key
scenes.image_prompt: Null's hand extended toward Kavi, holding a large, antique iron key, the background is a quiet, suburban neighborhood at twilight.

scenes.text: Take this, Null whispers, because the future is a choice you finally have to make.
scenes.caption: Choice is yours
scenes.image_prompt: Extreme close up of the iron key in Kavi's hand, Kavi's face determined and looking forward, the porch light flickering on.
